title: fix(plugin-security): the boot heal converges on duplicated permission-set names, and a refused existence read never inserts
body:
Fixes #22169

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong (measured on `main` at `6ed0c0f3e5`)

All three mechanisms the card names were confirmed on current `main` before any edit, with an in-repo reproduction: a real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3, in memory), a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, and the per-organization unique index dropped after schema sync. Dropping it gives the shape of a remote table built before the index retrofit, the only shape that can hold duplicates.

1. **The heal did not converge.** `reconcilePermissionSetProjection` handed each drifted, overlay-less record to `upsertEnvPermissionSet`, which re-read the record **by name** (first row, lowest id). With 8 declared names × 3 rows, boot 1 wrote 8 rows, logged 24 drift warnings and left 16 rows drifted. Boot 2, boot 3 and every later boot logged 16 warnings and wrote nothing.
2. **A layered read was discarded on every row.** `getMetaItemLayered` was awaited for every candidate row before the trust rule decided whether it needed the answer. While a `SchemaRegistry` is readable, the rule never uses it. One layered read is **4 statements** on the real protocol, so the shape above paid 24 × 4 per boot.
3. **A refused existence read inserted a duplicate.** `bootstrapPlatformAdmin` reads each default set by name through a `tryFind` that answers `[]` for a refused read, and it inserted on both "absent" and "refused". The heal's by-name upsert had the same insert branch. When by-name reads were refused, the unpatched heal inserted 24 rows (24 → 48) and the bootstrap inserted 2 more.

## The change (`@objectstack/plugin-security` only: 2 source files)

- `permission-set-projection.ts`, `reconcilePermissionSetProjection` heal branch:
  - **The heal writes the row it read, by its id, facets only.** It calls `tryUpdate` with `{ id: row.id, ...permissionSetRowFields(effective) }`, the same columns the upsert's update leg wrote. Identity, `active`, `customized` and provenance are not touched. The heal no longer asks an existence question, so it has no insert branch.
  - **The drift line is logged after the write.** It names the row's `id`, and a refused write is logged as refused instead of "re-projected". `driftHealed` counts landed writes, now one per drifted row.
  - **The layered read is lazy, once per name.** It is asked only when no `SchemaRegistry` answers, and the answer is cached per name for the pass. The cache entry is dropped after this pass backfills that name, because the backfill changes the answer. A later row of that name then sees the backfilled definition and heals to it, instead of backfilling a second time.
- `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts`, the default-set seed loop:
  - **A refused existence read declines the insert.** `tryFind`'s existing `onRefusal` observer tells "refused" apart from "empty".
  - **The pass says so once.** It writes one `warn` line per pass, not one per set, naming the sets. The line goes through `reportThroughSink`, the derivation the sibling seeders' unreadable lines use. When `admin_full_access` is one of the declined sets, the promotion half returns `admin_permission_set_unreadable` instead of `admin_permission_set_missing`. Nothing in the repository branches on that string; the only reads are doc comments.
- One `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-security`.

**Not changed (card scope):**

- No existing duplicate is deleted; that is an operator repair.
- `upsertEnvPermissionSet`'s per-item read on the live single-mutation path is unchanged. A refused read there still inserts.
- No change to `packages/spec`, no new gate.

## Measurement: statements per boot, in-repo reproduction

This was measured with the harness above on the fix at `5ccce70966` (source unchanged since; later commits touch tests and the changeset only). Each count is every SQL statement knex emitted during `reconcilePermissionSetProjection`. The harness was not committed.

| shape | boot | `main` `6ed0c0f3e5` | this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 names × 3 rows, all drifted | 1 | 148 statements (140 select / 8 update), 24 layered reads, 24 drift warns, 8 healed, **16 still drifted** | 76 statements (52 select / 24 update), 0 layered reads, 24 drift warns, 24 healed, 0 drifted |
| | 2, 3 | 116 statements, 24 layered reads, **16 drift warns**, 16 still drifted | **4 statements**, 0 layered reads, 0 warns |
| 60 names × 5 rows, all drifted | 1 | 1684 (1624 / 60), 300 layered reads, 300 warns, 60 healed, 240 still drifted | 904 (604 / 300), 0 layered reads, 300 warns, 300 healed, 0 drifted |
| | 2, 3 | 1444 statements, 300 layered reads, 240 drift warns | **4 statements**, 0 layered reads, 0 warns |
| by-name reads refused, 8 × 3 | heal + bootstrap | heal inserted 24, bootstrap inserted 2 (24 → 50 rows) | 0 inserts (24 → 24), 1 bootstrap line |

On the healing boot, each by-id `UPDATE` costs the engine one extra `SELECT`. That is the 52 − 4 = 48 selects for 24 updates.

⛔ **The hosted timing is not measured here.** The card's cloud reproduction (cloud's `ArtifactKernelFactory` on the hosted Turso face, ~36 ms per statement, 99.85 s / 170.70 s) cannot be reached from this session, and no cloud time is claimed. The before/after boot times on that reproduction belong to the cloud seat.

## Pins (new) and ablations

**Pins:**

- `permission-set-projection-heal-by-id.test.ts` (real engine, spied and never replaced; index dropped). Five cases:
  - A duplicated set heals once, by id, and the next boot logs no drift warn.
  - Control: a single drifted row heals as before.
  - No layered read while a registry answers.
  - Without a registry, the layered read happens once per name.
  - A refused by-name read inserts nothing.
- `bootstrap-platform-admin-refused-existence-read.test.ts`:
  - A refused read inserts nothing, logs one line and reports `admin_permission_set_unreadable`.
  - Two controls: an empty answer still seeds, and an existing row is left alone.
- `permission-set-projection.test.ts` gains one case: a just-backfilled name is re-read and the second row heals to the backfilled body, with one `saveMetaItem`, not two.

**Ablations.** Each leg ran on `e41760d89c` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with the anchor-hit count and blob change verified on disk. Each restore was proven with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The subjects are imported by relative path from `src/`, so no `dist/` leg applies.

| leg | mutation | result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | heal through the by-name upsert again | 4 red: duplicate heal wrote `['ps_a']` instead of `['ps_a','ps_b']`; refused read inserted 2; no-registry case `['ps_a']`; backfill case `driftHealed` 0. The control and the no-layered-read case stayed green. |
| A2 | eager per-row layered read restored | 3 red: no-layered-read case saw 6 reads instead of `[]`; once-per-name and backfill read counts were also red |
| A3 | per-name cache removed | 1 red: `['member_default','member_default']` instead of one read |
| A4 | post-backfill cache drop removed | 1 red: 2 `saveMetaItem` calls instead of 1 |
| A5 | bootstrap decline removed | 1 red: 3 inserts instead of `[]`; both controls stayed green |

A first A2 attempt was a refused no-op: its replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count stayed x1 → x1, nothing ran, and the restore was proven. It was re-run with a falling anchor.

## Verification (HEAD `e41760d89c`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 176 files, 3695 passed, 45 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` exits 0, including `check:test-typecheck` OK. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists all 3 touched test files.
- Gates:
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 66 commands, plus `pnpm check:durability-log-level`; all exit 0.
  - `--ran`: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - The first run, at `af7b0a339f`, had `check:engine-double-contract` and `check:objectql-double-limit` red on this PR's new test doubles. Both were fixed in `e41760d89c`: the heal tests spy on the real engine instead of an object-literal double, and the bootstrap double applies `limit` by presence after the filter.
- ESLint, narrowed and proven: 5 touched files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, run with `--no-inline-config --format json`.
  - All 5 files are in the population: `--print-config` resolves each, and no ignored-file warning was emitted.
  - The repository config never enables type-aware linting (`eslint.config.mjs`, no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- No plugin `init()`/`start()` or declaration was edited, so `check:init-service-contract` and `check:startup-registry-verdict` were not owed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured, not fixed (scope fence): the overlay pass leaves a duplicated overlay-backed name unconverged, silently.**
  - Probe: real engine, 2 drifted rows of `member_default` plus an active env `sys_metadata` overlay for it.
  - Boot 1 projected the overlay onto `ps_a` only, and `ps_b` kept its drifted facets on boots 1, 2 and 3 with 0 warnings. Step 1 resolves one row per name through `buildExistingByName`, and step 2 skips every overlay name.
  - It costs no boot time and logs nothing. It is display drift only, because enforcement reads the metadata definition. It is the same by-name family, outside this card's fence.
- **Reserved by the card for its own card:** `upsertEnvPermissionSet`'s per-item read on the live single-mutation path still inserts on a refused read.
  - `retirePermissionSetRecord` has the same by-name `LIMIT 1` shape: on a metadata delete it removes only the first row of a duplicated name. Read, not exercised.
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#15196's census marks this machinery for retirement in C3 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#15204, `pm:blocked`, not scheduled). C3 would delete these paths. That does not change this card.
